use IO.Std.write_line

apply[T.., U](f: T.. -> U, arguments: T..) -> U => f(arguments)

greet(greeting: string, name: string) -> string =>
    "{greeting}, {name}!"

volume(width: int, height: int, depth: int) -> int =>
    width * height * depth

let words = ("hello", "world")

let box = (width = 2, height = 3, depth = 4)

write_line(apply(greet, words))
write_line("{apply(volume, box)}")
write_line("{apply(volume, 5, 6, 7)}")

use IO.Std.write_line

    "{greeting}, {name}!"

volume(width: int, height: int, depth: int) -> int =>
    width * height * depth

let words = ("hello", "world")

let box = (width = 2, height = 3, depth = 4)

write_line(apply(greet, words))
write_line("{apply(volume, box)}")
